name: Boundary Creek Provincial Park
note: BC Parks car campground on Boundary Creek 4 km west of Greenwood on Hwy 3; 16 drive-in vehicle sites (rebuilt 2016 to accommodate larger RVs, no hookups), pit + flush toilets, water taps. 100% first-come, first-served (cash). Operated by Quality Recreation. --Claude

name: Inkaneep Provincial Park
note: BC Parks; 7 small vehicle-accessible sites on the east bank of the Okanagan River, 6 km N of Oliver on Hwy 97. Pit toilets, no hookups, RV length limit ~25 ft (best for tents/small RVs). First-come, first-served (self-registration vault, cash); open ~mid-May to late Sept. --Claude

name: Jewel Lake Provincial Park
note: BC Parks; 26 vehicle-accessible sites at the north end of Jewel Lake, 12 km E of Greenwood off Hwy 3. Pit toilets, hand-pump water, no hookups. First-come, first-served (self-registration vault, cash); open ~mid-May to late Sept. --Claude

name: Yahk Provincial Park
note: BC Parks vehicle-accessible frontcountry campground: 26 tent/RV sites in well-spaced forest by the Moyie River off Hwy 3/95 at Yahk; no hookups; reservable online plus some FCFS. Day-use area. --Claude

name: Mount Fernie Provincial Park
note: BC Parks frontcountry campground 3 km SW of Fernie on Hwy 3 along Lizard Creek: 69 sites (37 reservable, 21 drive-in tent/RV FCFS; 11 walk-in tent sites excluded); no hookups. Operated by EK Parks. --Claude

name: Norbury Lake Provincial Park
note: BC Parks vehicle-accessible campground between Norbury Lake and Peckham's Lake, ~16 km S of Fort Steele: 46 sites, each a short walk to a lake; no hookups; reservable online plus some FCFS. --Claude

name: Nancy Greene Provincial Park
note: BC Parks campground at sub-alpine Nancy Greene Lake by the Hwy 3/3B junction: 10 parking-lot-style drive-in sites (suited to small RVs as a stopover) plus 1 walk-in tent site; cash self-registration, First-come, first-served (no reservations); open ~mid-May to Sept 30. --Claude

name: Elk Falls Provincial Park (Quinsam Campground)
note: BC Parks Quinsam Campground on the Quinsam River near Campbell River: 122 sites (70 reservable in peak season, ~52 FCFS); no hookups; riverside loops (steelhead run past sites Nov-Mar). --Claude

name: Loveland Bay Provincial Park
note: Small rustic BC Parks campground at the north end of Lower Campbell Lake; ~31 sites (28 reservable + 3 FCFS), no hookups, max RV/trailer ~32 ft; boat launch. Access by active gravel logging roads (passable; expect logging trucks). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Morton Lake Provincial Park
note: BC Parks drive-in campground on Morton Lake; ~24 sites (mix reservable + ~10 FCFS), no hookups, max RV/trailer ~32 ft; boat launch. Access via ~19 km of gravel roads (Menzies Main + Morton Lake Rd). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Strathcona Provincial Park - Ralph River Campground
note: BC Parks drive-in campground at the Ralph River mouth on Buttle Lake, Strathcona PP; ~75 sites (20 reservable + 55 FCFS), no hookups, max RV/trailer ~32 ft. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Kitty Coleman Beach Provincial Park
note: Class C provincial park run by a community park board, 6 km NW of Courtenay. 65 vehicle-accessible drive-in oceanfront sites on the Strait of Georgia with pit toilets and running water, no hookups; open ~mid-Apr to Sep. First-come, first-served (not on the BC Parks reservation system) — call the caretaker. --Claude

name: Saltery Bay Provincial Park
note: BC Parks car campground ~1 km N of the Saltery Bay ferry terminal on Georgia Strait, 27 km S of Powell River; 42 forested drive-in sites (21 reservable, rest FCFS), most fit RVs to 32 ft, no hookups but sani-dump and pit toilets on site. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Kekuli Bay Provincial Park
note: BC Parks campground on the W side of Kalamalka Lake, 11 km S of Vernon; ~73 large grassy drive-in sites (4 with electrical), sites to 45 ft, boat launch, flush toilets, no showers. Reservable online (some FCFS). --Claude

name: Fintry Provincial Park
note: Fintry Provincial Park: large frontcountry campground (100+ vehicle-accessible sites, most RV-suitable incl very long 90+ ft pull-ins and some 50-amp), showers/flush toilets, ~2 km of Okanagan Lake sandy beach; ~85% reservable, rest FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Kokanee Creek Provincial Park
note: Kokanee Creek Provincial Park: four campgrounds - Sandspit (113 sites, paved, showers/flush toilets), Redfish (19, creekside FCFS), Osprey (18), Friends (39 incl 13 electric); on the West Arm of Kootenay Lake 19 km E of Nelson on Hwy 3A; mix of reservable and FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: McDonald Creek Provincial Park
note: McDonald Creek Provincial Park: ~111 vehicle-accessible sites (32 electrified, 32 with direct beach access) on Upper Arrow Lake, 16 km S of Nakusp on Hwy 6; coin sani-station + RV water fill, boat launch; mix reservable/FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Summit Lake Provincial Park
note: Drive-in provincial park campground on a small peninsula in Summit Lake, 18 km SE of Nakusp on Hwy 6; 35 vehicle-accessible sites (23 reservable), no hookups, boat launch. Reservable online; remaining sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Rosebery Provincial Park
note: Small, secluded BC Parks campground on the banks of Wilson Creek near Slocan Lake, off Hwy 6 at Rosebery; 33 vehicle-accessible sites incl 6 pull-throughs (9 reservable), no hookups. Reservable online; remaining sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Wasa Lake Provincial Park
note: Popular BC Parks campground on the east side of warm Wasa Lake off Hwy 93/95; 104 grassy vehicle sites (66 reservable), flush toilets, showers, dump station, no hookups; accommodates long RVs. Reservable online; remaining sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Kootenay Lake Provincial Park - Davis Creek Campground
note: BC Parks Davis Creek campground on the NW shore of Kootenay Lake, 25 km N of Kaslo on Hwy 31; 32 drive-in sites, beach and boat access. Cove Loop sites 1-10 reservable online; remaining sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Whiteswan Lake Provincial Park - Alces Lake Campground
note: Whiteswan Lake Provincial Park's Alces Lake campground (km 21 on the gravel Whiteswan FSR), 28 vehicle-accessible sites fitting RVs to ~50 ft, no hookups, on Alces Lake. First-come, first-served (no site reservations); self-register at fee station. Gravel FSR access—use caution on the canyon section. --Claude

name: Nairn Falls Provincial Park
note: BC Parks: 94 drive-in sites (92 reservable, 2 FCFS; max RV 32 ft/10 m) along the Green River on Hwy 99 ~3 km S of Pemberton; short trail to Nairn Falls. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Birkenhead Lake Provincial Park
note: BC Parks: ~90 RV-friendly drive-in sites (incl. 7 double sites; 35+ FCFS, remainder reservable) in forest above Birkenhead Lake, reached by a 17 km gravel road off Hwy 99 at D'Arcy; day-use beach. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Lac Le Jeune Provincial Park
note: Large provincial-park campground on Lac Le Jeune 37 km south of Kamloops off Hwy 5; ~144 sites (91 reservable, rest FCFS), medium-to-large sites with some pull-throughs, no hookups, sani-station. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Paul Lake Provincial Park
note: Provincial park on Paul Lake 19 km northeast of Kamloops via paved Pinantan Rd; 90 vehicle-accessible sites (47 reservable, rest FCFS), max RV ~27 ft, no hookups, sani-station, beach and cartop boat launch. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Adams Lake Provincial Park - Bush Creek Site
note: BC Parks rustic campground on the SW shore of Adams Lake, 15 km up a gravel road from Squilax (Hwy 1); 27 vehicle-accessible sites plus 4 walk-in, fire rings only, no potable water, no hookups, no pull-throughs, suited to campers and small trailers. Sandy beach and gravel boat launch. First-come, first-served, roughly May 15-Sep 30. --Claude

name: Tunkwa Lake Provincial Park
note: Large BC Parks fishing-lake campground SW of Kamloops near Logan Lake; 275 unserviced sites across three areas (Tunkwa Lake, Leighton and North Leighton) on Tunkwa and Leighton lakes, fire pits and picnic tables, accommodates oversized RVs. First-come, first-served (a few designated long-stay sites). --Claude

name: Lac La Hache Provincial Park
note: 83-site campground on Lac La Hache, ~13 km N of Lac La Hache off Hwy 97; flush toilets, tap water, sani-station, no hookups; accommodates large motorhomes. 31 sites reservable, rest FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Green Lake Provincial Park - Sunset View
note: Sunset View campground in Green Lake Provincial Park (south shore of Green Lake): 54 drive-in vehicle sites plus 4 walk-in tent sites (walk-ins excluded); boat launch, no hookups. Mix of reservable and FCFS sites. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Green Lake Provincial Park - Emerald Bay
note: Emerald Bay campground, 51 drive-in sites in Green Lake Provincial Park; some double sites accommodate RVs up to 32 ft, no hookups. Mix of reservable and FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Big Bar Lake Provincial Park
note: Big Bar Lake Provincial Park on Big Bar Lake, ~40 km NW of Clinton; 46 sites across Lakeside (27) and Upper (19) campgrounds, 10 high-density sites fit larger rigs, 1 pull-through, no hookups. 20 sites reservable, rest FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Green Lake Provincial Park - Arrowhead
note: Arrowhead campground, 16 drive-in sites in Green Lake Provincial Park; most sites suit RVs under 18 ft but a few accommodate up to 32 ft, no hookups. Mix of reservable and FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Martha Creek Provincial Park
note: Martha Creek Provincial Park on Lake Revelstoke (Revelstoke Reservoir), ~20 km N of Revelstoke on Hwy 23; ~76 sites, no hookups but coin-op sani-station with RV fill, paved boat launch, beach, playground. About 52 sites reservable, rest FCFS. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Tweedsmuir (South) Provincial Park - Atnarko Campground
note: Campground in old-growth forest on the Atnarko River at the bottom of 'the Hill' on Hwy 20, between Anahim Lake and Bella Coola; 15 vehicle-accessible sites, most trailers/RVs accommodated, no hookups, pit toilets. Mix of reservable and first-come, first-served. Heavy grizzly activity - hard-sided camping advised. --Claude

name: Lowhee Campground (Barkerville)
note: Campground at Barkerville Historic Town (BC provincial heritage site) along Williams Creek off Hwy 26, elev ~1230 m. 80 sites (47 reservable + 33 FCFS), avg ~50 ft x 14 ft, flush toilets, showers; fits most RVs/trailers, no hookups. Operated by the Barkerville Heritage Trust. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Cedar Point Provincial Park
note: BC Parks campground on Quesnel Lake, 6 km from Likely. 29 vehicle-accessible sites (15 reservable), boat launch; drive-in RV/tent, no hookups. Reserve or FCFS via the park operator. --Claude

name: Wells Gray Provincial Park - Clearwater Lake Campground
note: BC Parks vehicle-accessible campground at the north end of Clearwater Lake (boat launch/lake access); ~40 sites, no hookups, pit toilets. Half reservable, half first-come; the best riverside sites (17-26) are first-come, first-served. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Mount Robson Provincial Park - Lucerne Campground
note: BC Parks campground on the south shore of Yellowhead Lake near the Alberta boundary off Hwy 16; 36 vehicle sites (2 walk-in excluded), no hookups, pit toilets, some sites to ~35 ft. Mix of reservable and first-come, first-served (fills early). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Naikoon Provincial Park - Agate Beach Campground
note: BC Parks campground on North Beach (Hecate Strait) in Naikoon Park on Haida Gwaii, ~26 km east of Masset on Tow Hill Rd near Tow Hill; 32 vehicle sites (11 tent), pit toilets, water, roofed kitchen shelter, no hookups. First-come, first-served - cash only, no reservations. --Claude
